# Gildongmu (길동무)

> Gildongmu is a free navigation and place-information service for South Korea, built accessibility-first: blind and low-vision users can complete the entire flow of search, place details, and directions through a screen reader alone. Available on the web and as an iOS app, with the interface in Korean, English, Spanish, French, Italian, and Japanese. No account required.

Key facts:

- All information is presented as text. There is no map view; for real-time driving navigation the app hands off to Naver Map or KakaoMap.
- Directions preview covers car, public transit, and walking routes as text briefings before departure. Walking routes offer a stair-free option.
- Nearby information includes real-time subway arrivals, buses, late-night pediatric clinics, barrier-free tourist sites, and pedestrian infrastructure such as audible signals. Some datasets (bike share, cultural events, crowd levels) cover Seoul.
- Station information covers facilities, first and last train times, and elevator locations for subway stations nationwide.
- AI chat answers questions about places using live data.
- Name-based features (place search, station information, directions to a destination) work worldwide; current-location features work only within South Korea.
